scope: Two reply delete controls receive canonical icon rules; UDI selection delegates to shared choiceLook with explicit false for absent keys and exposes its toggle state. BackwardsPlanner removes a square-control radius override. The onboarding title becomes an h1 with central zero margin. Full-file equality rejects any other change. No new argument or changed line is approved.

            style={{
              fontFamily: QDScale.family.serif,
              fontWeight: "var(--qd-font-weight-semibold)",

              color: T.text,
              lineHeight: QDScale.leading.tight,
              margin: QDScale.space[0],
